_about: Page-level edits from the 20 Sep 2026 editorial review: the two hand-written pages (Code Against Cancer, timeline), the three games and the 404 page. Official Code recommendation wording is untouched; only EpiDetective's own labels, notes and page furniture change.

<link rel="alternate icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any">

</title>
edits.new:

edits.old: <meta name="description" content="Official, evidence-based ways to reduce your own cancer risk, from the regional Codes Against Cancer developed by IARC (WHO) and its partners in Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia.">

<link rel="canonical" href="https://epidetective.com/code-against-cancer/">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="EpiDetective">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://epidetective.com/code-against-cancer/">

edits.why: Every other page carries a canonical link and the Open Graph set; this one carried neither.

edits.old: document.documentElement.lang = lang;
edits.why: With ?lang=fr the page was fully French while the tab, the bookmark and anything shared still read English.

edits.old: ''+i18n("coordinated",lang)+": "+esc(pick(r.partner,lang))+''
edits.new: ''+i18n("coordinated",lang)+(lang==="zh"?"：":lang==="fr"?"\u202f: ":": ")+esc(pick(r.partner,lang))+''
edits.why: Chinese renders a half-width colon after 协调方; Chinese punctuation is full width. French takes a narrow no-break space before the colon.

edits.old: 它与肺癌存在因果关系
edits.new: 空气污染与肺癌存在因果关系
edits.why: The nearest noun to 它 was 户外活动, so the sentence read as "outdoor activity causes lung cancer".

edits.old: IARC（世界卫生组织癌症研究机构）
edits.new: IARC（世界卫生组织国际癌症研究机构）
edits.why: IARC's Chinese name is 国际癌症研究机构.

edits.old: Избегайте чрезмерного пребывания на солнце, особенно детям.
edits.new: Избегайте чрезмерного пребывания на солнце; особенно берегите от него детей.
edits.why: The imperative addresses вы and then a dative appears with nothing to agree with.

edits.old: ограничьте продукты с высоким содержанием калорий, сахара, жира и соли, сладкие напитки и ультрапереработанные продукты.
edits.new: ограничьте продукты с высоким содержанием калорий, сахара, жира и соли; ограничьте сладкие напитки и пейте в основном воду и напитки без сахара; ограничьте ультрапереработанные продукты.
edits.why: The Russian card dropped the official instruction to drink mostly water and unsweetened drinks, which every other language carries.

edits.old: избегайте переработанного мяса и ограничьте красное
edits.new: избегайте переработанного мяса и ограничьте красное мясо
edits.why: Without the noun the adjective is left hanging.

edits.old: Limitez le THS de la ménopause
edits.new: Limitez le traitement hormonal de la ménopause
edits.why: A bare English abbreviation in a card title; French health agencies write traitement hormonal de la ménopause.

edits.old: Pensez à H. pylori
edits.new: Dépistez H. pylori
edits.why: The recommendation is to be screened and treated, which "pensez à" does not say.

edits.old: elle est une cause avérée de cancer du poumon
edits.new: c'est une cause avérée de cancer du poumon
edits.why: "elle" has no antecedent in the French sentence.

edits.old: IARC y la Comisión Europea
edits.new: CIIC y la Comisión Europea
edits.why: The Spanish name of the agency is CIIC, which both tools and the site footer already use.

edits.old: IARC y OPS (Organización Panamericana de la Salud)
edits.new: CIIC y OPS (Organización Panamericana de la Salud)
edits.why: Same.

edits.old: IARC y ANCCA (Alianza de Centros Nacionales del Cáncer de Asia)
edits.new: CIIC y ANCCA (Alianza de Centros Nacionales del Cáncer de Asia)
edits.why: Same.

edits.old: Reduzca la contaminación del aire
edits.new: Reduzca su exposición a la contaminación del aire
edits.why: The official recommendation is about reducing your exposure; an individual cannot reduce air pollution.

edits.old: summaryNote:"The official Code has no English edition; below is an EpiDetective summary."
edits.new:
summaryNote:"The official Code has no English edition; below is an EpiDetective summary.",
    devNote:"No Asian Code has been published yet. The ten points below are EpiDetective's summary of the themes mapped by IARC and ANCCA.",
    affiliation:"EpiDetective is a personal project by Wenxin Wan, produced in a personal capacity. It carries no endorsement from the International Agency for Research on Cancer or the World Health Organization."
edits.why: Adds the in-development note and the affiliation line (en).

edits.new:
summaryNote:"El Código oficial de esta región no se publica en español; lo que sigue es un resumen de EpiDetective.",

edits.new:

    devNote:"Азиатский кодекс ещё не опубликован. Десять пунктов ниже — краткое изложение тем, намеченных МАИР и ANCCA.",

edits.new:
var note = r.dev ? '

'+esc(i18n("devNote",lang))+'

' : (r.officialLangs && r.officialLangs.indexOf(lang) < 0) ? '

edits.why: The one region whose Code is still being developed was the only one with no note, so its ten cards read like a published Code.

edits.old: Compiled by EpiDetective from IARC / PAHO / ANCCA public materials. Please refer to the official sources above for the definitive wording and updates.
edits.new:
Compiled by EpiDetective from IARC / PAHO / ANCCA public materials. Please refer to the official sources above for the definitive wording and updates.

EpiDetective is a personal project by Wenxin Wan, produced in a personal capacity. It carries no endorsement from the International Agency for Research on Cancer or the World Health Organization.
edits.why: This is the page most likely to be read as an official IARC publication, and it was the only one without the affiliation note.
